sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial Shipbuilding of Deep-Sea Dry Cargo and Container Vessels

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (OECD/Council of Europe, extended to Colombia)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 2010 of 2019 (Article 69), regulatory Decree 830 of 2021, and Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolution 20211000096855 of 2021 (UBO Registry); Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation); Decree 663 of 1993 (Estatuto Orgánico del Sistema Financiero); Superintendencia de Sociedades External Circular 100-000008 of 2022 (AML/CFT obligations for supervised non-financial sectors); Article 323 of Law 599 of 2000 (Criminal Code – money laundering); Law 1762 of 2015 (anti-tax-fraud AML amendments).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Incorporation and Constitution Minutes (Acta de Constitución / Estatutos Sociales)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders executed before a Colombian Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores or notarized authentication for domestic documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Incorporation granted by non-resident shareholder(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign notary or equivalent competent authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Apostille Convention) or Consular Legalization for non-Apostille treaty states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if destined for foreign bank or overseas counterparty

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner and the future legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign residents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: PEP and Sanctions Risk Disclosure Form (Formulario de Debida Diligencia PEP/Sanciones)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporation counsel or designated AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and, where applicable, Hague Apostille

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, Colombian UIAF and DIAN lists; integrated enhanced due diligence (EDD) for Foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, and family/close associates; source of funds and source of wealth verification; public-record triangulation and adverse media search; documented in an AML file retained for at least ten years after termination of relationship. Must be completed prior to submitting incorporation documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES (operated by Confecámaras and local Cámaras de Comercio)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Spanish using Latin script; accents and special characters are permitted but must follow Colombian linguistic conventions; the name must include the structural suffix 'S.A.S.'; Spanish transliteration is required for names originally expressed in foreign alphabets; abbreviations and misleading terms are restricted.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Términos que sugieran actividad regulada sin la licencia previa correspondiente
Nombres que reproduzcan marcas o signos distintivos idénticos ya registrados
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name pre-reservation is automatically held for thirty calendar days with a single extension request permitted for another thirty days if filed before expiration. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same Chamber of Commerce within five business days, attaching a revised alternative name or legal arguments demonstrating compliance with Article 649 of the Commercial Code and Decree 19 of 2012. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may pursue recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). A new pre-reservation request and payment of the corresponding tariff will be necessary if the matter is not resolved before the reservation window lapses.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual/administrative office is not permissible as the sole commercial substance for a commercial shipyard registered under ISIC 3011. The company must maintain a physical registered establishment, industrial plant or authorized operational site in Colombia for the actual construction, refitting, or repair of deep-sea dry cargo and container vessels. A legal/registered address for correspondence and tax domicile may be an administratively separate location, but the maritime industrial activity requires a substantive physical premises approved by the Dirección General Marítima (DIMAR) and other competent authorities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High for the operational shipyard facility (estimated 70–85% probability of unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation by DIMAR, DIAN, Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, corruption prevention bodies, and labor authorities); moderate for the administrative registered office (estimated 30% probability of inspection if the office is virtual and used only for registry correspondence).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name pre-reservation (pre-rúbrica) in RUES and Chamber of Commerce system
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (via RUES)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Cámara de Comercio tariff schedule (Estatuto Único de Tarifas, Resolution 120-... of the respective Chamber)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authorization and certification of incorporation minutes and statutory documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) designated by the incorporators
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff (Decreto 960 de 1970; tariff framework of the Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization of foreign shareholder powers of attorney and UBO forms
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (Dirección de Apostillas) and Colombian Consulates abroad
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fees governing apostille and consular legalization services (Law 40 of 1997; Decreto 1069 de 2015)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration (matrícula mercantil), RUES registration, and issuance of certificate of existence and legal representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Chamber of Commerce tariff schedule and Article 26 of the Commercial Code (Decreto 410 de 1971); Law 1727 de 2014

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry filing (Registro de Beneficiarios Final) with Superintendencia de Sociedades
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades (filing via RUES electronic portal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No public fee beyond Chamber of Commerce processing tariff; eventual notarial fees for verification; Resolution 20211000096855 de 2021

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and Colombian sanctions screening; AML/CFT due diligence; conflict-of-interest clearance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Incorporation counsel, AML compliance specialists, and external database subscription fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border corporate due diligence and AML package (hourly or fixed-fee engagement)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio, Decree 410 of 1971), Book II; Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1–48; Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 100-000001 of 2021
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Registro Único Empresarial – RUE); national oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument) and By-laws (Estatutos Sociales) registered in the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S.; stated capital may be subscribed without immediate payment, with terms fixed in the by-laws. No escrow account requirement imposed at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: FIRST, that the Sole Shareholder subscribes 1,000 ordinary shares with a par value of COP 1,000 each, fully subscribed and with paid-in capital payable in cash or in-kind contributions; SECOND, that the registered office is established within the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Commerce of Cartagena, Bolívar; THIRD, that [Name] is appointed Legal Representative and [Name] is appointed Deputy Legal Representative; FOURTH, that the Legal Representative is authorized to complete the mercantile registry registration, the DIAN tax registration, and the opening of bank accounts and escrow facilities; FIFTH, that these resolutions shall be recorded in the corporate minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation (Consultas y Reserva de Denominación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio – Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed company names through the Chamber's virtual portal; verify absence of identical or confusingly similar registered names; obtain the official name reservation certificate, valid for 30 calendar days, before filing incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Three alternative proposed company names
Applicant identity document (cédula de ciudadanía or valid passport)
Legal representative identity document and email
Completed name reservation form (available on the RUE portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Immediately file a second alternative name list on the same portal; if the registry raises confusion objections, submit a written reconsideration request or proceed with the next available alternative within the reservation validity period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Notarized or Private Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) or authorized digital notary platform; confirmation by the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lawyer drafts the S.A.S. by-laws; all founding shareholders execute the incorporation instrument before a notary or through notarized remote signatures; obtain notarial certification of signatures and legal capacity; retain certified copy for submission to the Chamber.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws (Estatutos Sociales) of the S.A.S.
Chamber name reservation certificate
Valid identity documents of all founding shareholders
Power of attorney if a representative signs on behalf of a shareholder
Notarial certification of signature authenticity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies formal defects, correct the instrument by adding a rectification or amendment annex; re-notarize the corrected document and proceed with registration before the Chamber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registry Filing and Registration Before the Chamber of Commerce (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local jurisdiction of registered office – Cartagena, Bolívar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation instrument, completed registration form, and payment of registration fees with the Chamber; after substantive review, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, confirming legal existence and representative powers.
required_dossiers: Execution of Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
Chamber name reservation certificate
Registration form (Formulario de Registro Mercantil)
Pre-assignment of NIT form issued by DIAN (obtained during or before Chamber filing)
Payment receipt of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Chamber's correction notices within the specified cure period; resubmit corrected documents digitally; if the registration is rejected, lodge an administrative appeal before the Chamber's internal registry authority or request judicial review before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration Before DIAN (NIT and RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the preliminary NIT during the Chamber registration process; after issuance of the Mercantile Registry Certificate, complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) on the DIAN portal, selecting ISIC 3011 as the primary economic activity; obtain the electronic signature (firma electrónica) for future filings and invoicing.
required_dossiers: Mercantile Registry Certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
RUT pre-registration form (pre-RUT)
Legal representative identity document
By-laws (Estatutos Sociales)
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify incorrect RUT fields through the DIAN virtual portal; if DIAN invokes a non-attendance or documentary observation, submit a written correction through the citizen service office or request assistance from an authorized tax agent; escalate the matter through the DIAN's PQR system if unresolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Legal Representatives and Corporate Officers in the Chamber Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (same jurisdiction as registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the certificate of appointment of the Legal Representative and Deputy Legal Representative, executed by the Sole Shareholder or Board of Directors as per the by-laws; submit signed acceptance letters and criminal background certificates; the Chamber registers the scope of representative powers.
required_dossiers: Signed acceptance letters (carta de aceptación de cargos)
Copy of the shareholder or board decision appointing officers
Criminal record certificates of the appointed officers
Valid identity documents of appointees
Mercantile Registry Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct or supplement appointing documents if the Chamber files observations; re-file a supplementary registration via the RUE portal and pay any applicable minor fee for re-registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certification and Opening of Corporate Books (Libros de Actas, Registro de Accionistas, and Corporate Book Sealing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio – Registry of Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare bound corporate books for minutes and share registration; present them to the Chamber for certification and sealing before recording any entry; the first board resolution and share subscription entries shall be recorded in the certified books immediately after sealing.
required_dossiers: Corporate minute book (Libro de Actas)
Shareholders' register (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Mercantile Registry Certificate
Form requesting book certification and sealing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects the books due to physical defects or incorrect formatting, rebind or substitute the books, present the corrected versions, and reapply; no substantive history is lost as no entries were recorded prior to certification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General Marítima (DIMAR) – Ministerio de Defensa Nacional, in coordination with Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for industrial standards and consumer/industrial safety requirements
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación de Astillero (Shipyard Operation License) issued by DIMAR

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Assessment (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) and Environmental License (Licencia Ambiental) required for industrial shipyard construction and operation; classified under the high-impact category subject to ANLA screening pursuant to Decree 1076 of 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolution 631 of 2015 (e.g., pH 6.0–9.0, DQO ≤ 300 mg/L, SST ≤ 50 mg/L); atmospheric emission standards per Resolution 2254 of 2017, including VOC and PM thresholds for industrial shipyard operations; hazardous waste handling and disposal per Decree 4741 of 2007 and Resolution 1362 of 2007.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Municipal Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos); structural load inspection and land-use/zoning permit from the Municipal Planning Office (Curaduría Urbana); occupational health and workplace safety clearance from the Ministerio del Trabajo, together with mandatory social security registration for all shipyard employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – principal tax and customs authority; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: https://muisca.dian.gov.co; foreign trade customs portal via SIIT/VUCE.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (SAS) obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through DIAN. Procedure: (1) incorporate the SAS via the local Cámara de Comercio; (2) obtain the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) online at DIAN by filing the official registration form using a legal representative; (3) for non-resident shareholders, submit legalized passport copies, power of attorney for the Colombian legal representative, and the due diligence forms required by anti-money-laundering rules; (4) DIAN assigns the NIT and updates the RUT; the NIT/RUT must be displayed on invoices and all tax filings. Foreign entities without a permanent establishment may register a limited-purpose NIT for VAT/digital services obligations when required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Colombian tax law. Available statutory elections: (i) optional consolidated taxation for business groups under Articles 21-23 of the Tax Code (Régimen de Tributación de Grupos) where sub-subsidiaries may be structurally neutralized; (ii) election to qualify as a Sociedad Holding Colombiana (CHC) to obtain reduced withholding and foreign dividend/capital gains treatment under Article 496 and related provisions; (iii) election for application of income-tax consolidation and deferred recognition rules under the Economic Growth Law (Law 1943/2018). Hybrid mismatch elections are not separately recognized; anti-hybrid rules under BEPS Action 2 are incorporated via Art. 113-2 and Treaty anti-abuse clauses.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) – standard VAT regime administered by DIAN
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 / no threshold – any person that performs taxable sales of goods or services, or imports goods, must register in the RUT and be VAT-responsible; foreign digital suppliers must register through a mandatory simplified VAT registration if their sales to Colombian clients exceed the equivalent of 40,000 UVTs per year (approx. COP 0 is not applicable to goods exports).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) for all VAT-responsible taxpayers. Invoices must be generated through software authorized by DIAN, transmitted via SOAP/REST web services to DIAN's clearing platform, and must contain the CUDE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and a two-dimensional verification code. All payments for taxable sales, including installments under a export letter of credit, are covered. Customs export operations require an electronic export declaration (DEX) lodged through the SIIT (Sistema Informático de Servicios de Informática Aduanera) with automatic non-intrusive validation by DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are excluded from VAT (no IVA causado) under Article 481 of the Colombian Tax Code provided the goods physically leave the country under a customs export declaration (DEX). Services may be excluded where the service is used or exploited abroad and the final beneficiary is a non-resident, subject to the condition that the service does not constitute a taxable service performed in Colombia for domestic consumption; the operation must be supported by a contract, invoice, and foreign-exchange remittance. Exporters may recover VAT paid on inputs (saldo a favor) via DIAN refund petitions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación y/o DEX)
Bill of Lading (Conocimiento de Embarque) or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro presentado al Banco de la República / intermediario del mercado cambiario)
Certificate of Origin (if preferential treatment is claimed)
Export freight and insurance documents when charged separately
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN scrutinizes export refund claims through post-clearance audits and may review the DEX, bills of lading, bank remittances, and beneficial ownership of the foreign buyer. A fraudulent or unjustified export refund triggers a clawback of the refunded VAT plus moratory interest computed under Article 635 ET, a penalty of up to 200% of the misdeclared or omitted tax under Article 655 ET, and possible criminal liability under the Customs Anticontrabando regime (Law 1762/2015). False documentation also invalidates the exclusion and exposes the taxpayer to sanctions for irregular export declarations, suspension of exporters' registry status, and legal representatives' joint liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) jointly with the Comité de Cambios Internacionales and the Fiscalía General de la Nación; the Registro de Inversores is operated by Banco de la República through the Sistema Integral de Gestión de Devoluciones y Movimientos (SIGDM) and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises exchange intermediaries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed free-currency regime: all foreign-exchange transactions of a current-account nature are freely convertible except for certain obligatory channeling through authorized financial intermediaries. Capital-account operations, including foreign direct investment (FDI) into an SAS shipyard, are permitted without prior authorization, but must be registered with Banco de la República through the applicable 'Declaración de Cambio' forms. Profit remittances and the repatriation of registered capital are permitted provided such foreign investment is duly registered and the remittance is economically grounded in audited financial statements. The main remaining hurdle is documentary: a full tax residence or foreign identification certificate, proof of source of funds, and a local tax identification number (NIT) for the SAS; if the shipyard operates under a free-trade zone (zona franca), additional customs privileges apply but exchange-channeling obligations persist.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Colombian exchange regulations (Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, Chapter 1, Title 1), all export proceeds from goods related to shipbuilding must be channeled through the foreign-exchange market (Mercado Cambiario) by selling the hard currency to a Colombian commercial bank or depositing it into a foreign-currency account registered with Banco de la República within 6 months of the date of shipment or the date the export is completed; a one-time extension of up to 3 months may be requested before the original term expires. A mandatory surrender ratio of 100% of the export invoice value, in the exact currency of the invoice, was historically observed for most goods; in effect today the exporter must exchange the proceeds through an authorized intermediary or demonstrate continued holding in a registered foreign-currency deposit account, with no unfettered retention offshore. For shipyard exports, the actual proceeds must match the customs declaration (Declaración de Exportación) and the supporting maritime vessel-purchase contract; any variance must be justified by the exporter to the DIAN and Banco de la República.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Treasury Hedging Line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital electronic-money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise, Airwallex, or Payoneer do not hold Colombian banking licenses nor an in-country exchange-intermediary authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; they therefore cannot legally execute the mandatory Colombian foreign-exchange channeling or provide local COP-denominated settlement for an SAS shipyard. Such EMIs may only be used as auxiliary invoicing or payment rails where no capital-account registration or export-surrender event is triggered; any attempt to use them as the primary corporate treasury vehicle would create unregistered offshore balances, triggering AML/CFT red flags and violations of Circular DCIN-83.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Colombian SAS continuously owned by one or more non-resident shareholders, the legal representative (representante legal) and at least one beneficial owner of the holding entity must, as a general rule, attend a personal KYC interview at the selected bank's offices in Colombia. Most tier-1 Colombian banks expressly require in-person identity verification for the company's legal representatives and principal shareholders/managers; remote opening is only available on a narrow exception basis for established low-risk direct investment structures, and even then, a notarized and apostilled power of attorney must be granted to a Colombian resident attorney or accountant who appears physically at the bank and signs the account mandate. For the shipbuilding sector, classified under 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced', the KYC interview cannot be fully waived; a video conference may supplement but not replace the physical appearance requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial ownership with no Colombian NIT or no local physical office for the SAS
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled certificate of good standing of the sole/ultimate parent; a complete organizational chart showing every individual holding more than 10% of shares; passport copies and residence certificates of all beneficial owners; audited consolidated financial statements not older than 12 months; a written statement of source of funds and source of wealth; power of attorney in Spanish, legalized by the nearest Colombian consulate or apostilled, appointing the Colombian legal representative; Colombian NIT registration certificate (Registro Único Tributario, RUT) of the SAS; commercial registry certificate from the Cámara de Comercio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial shipbuilding customer payment flows relying on offshore escrow or large pre-delivery installments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full copy of the export vessel-sale contract (in Spanish or annotated translation), including vessel IMO number, payment schedule, and delivery milestones; draft or authentic bill-of-lading/switching contract; the underlying customs export registration; certificate of eligibility of the shipyard under ISIC 3011 and the current shipbuilding license; evidence that all installments are receivable in a Colombian authorized-intermediary account, or in a permissible registered offshore foreign-currency account if prior approval was granted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to related-party offshore equipment and design-supply consultants
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive transfer-pricing study (Estudio de Precios de Transferencia) for the fiscal year covering the cross-border related-party transactions; OECD-compliant transactional documentation; commercial contracts with payment terms and SWIFT confirmations; certificates from beneficiary entities proving economic substance and invoicing capacity; annual transfer-pricing declaration stored for DIAN; bank source-of-funds statements for each related-party supplier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Participation of politically exposed persons (PEPs) or heritage-oil buyers in the global container-vessel procurement chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated PEP declarations from all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners; beneficial ownership registers of the customer, if available; enhanced due-diligence report prepared by a third-party KYC vendor; transaction monitoring plan; written sanctions screening; attestation that the transaction does not involve Colombian-Sanctioned or OFAC-sanctioned persons and that ESMA, BIS, or national licensing requirements are met.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection by non-resident shareholders must be effected through a wire transfer from an offshore bank in the denominated hard currency (usually USD) to an authorized Colombian commercial bank where the SAS holds its 'Capital Escrow Account'. The originator must include the precise remittance description: 'Foreign Direct Investment – Capital contribution to SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES SIMPLIFICADA SAS / NIT 900.000.000-0 / ISIC 3011'; the receiving bank will generate the 'Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional' (the statutory purpose-code and classification form). This filing enters the investment into the Banco de la República registry within the permitted time frame, producing a registration certificate that is subsequently required for dividend remittance and the eventual repatriation of capital. All proof of remittance (SWIFT MT103, bank credit note, deed of capital increase registered at the Notaría and Cámara de Comercio) must be preserved. Exchange control verification includes matching the remittance to the audited accounting entry 'Aportes sociales / capital' and checking that the funds are not sourced from BC/FT and do not cross an OFAC-sanctioned correspondent. The omnibus account number and ABA/IBAN advices must be obtained before executing the transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for shipbuilding procurement and subcontracting will primarily clear via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 messages to the beneficiary banks, each citing a valid purchase order, pro-forma invoice, and a purpose description in Spanish consistent with exchange-control classification. For larger equipment purchases abroad (e.g., engines, plate steel, navigation systems), a Commercial Letter of Credit is opened on the Colombian bank’s side, using the MT700/MT707 series and subjecting the documents to UCP600; the shipyard’s purchased materials are settled against presentation of a full set of shipping documents (commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, insurance). The on-balance-sheet CKDs and raw-materials import must be accompanied by the DIAN import declaration and, if applicable, a customs-bond note; such payments are permitted through the authorized intermediary without needing the prior Banco de la República license as long as the import invoice and customs entry are filed in the SIGDM. No cash or irrevocable-payment-order settlement may bypass the Colombian bank corridor through an offshore payable or virtual-currency arrangement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable forward contracts entered through an authorized Colombian commercial bank, provided the underlying transaction is a genuine forecast export/import obligation of the SAS shipyard and cannot be speculative

Dollar-peso non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed via a local licensed intermediary or an international broker when settlement under Colombian clearing rules must take place in COP without physical exchange

Cross-currency swaps (basis swaps) in USD vs COP for duration-matched finance of the vessel-construction cash flows, documented under ISDA 2002 and in compliance with Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia ownership and limit rules
Vanilla currency options (purchased by the SAS) embedded in the export contract or arranged with the local bank, provided premiums are paid in the authorized banking channel

Field-of-use commodity or bunker-price hedges are treated as separate linear instruments and are permitted only if they concern the shipyard’s actual cost exposures and are registered for exchange-control purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual renewal of commercial registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Cámara de Comercio where the S.A.S. maintains its commercial registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March of each calendar year; the renewal covers the registrant's continued commercial existence for the relevant year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Mercantile registration may be cancelled under Decree 898/2002; the company loses the ability to register subsequent corporate acts, and the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose additional fines; reinstatement requires full renewal plus arrears and late-filing charges.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting approving financial statements, management report, and appointment of auditor or revisor fiscal, if required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minute book; approved financial statements deposited with the Cámara de Comercio and available to the Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March following the 31 December statutory fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Any shareholder may request judicial convocation; the legal representative may be fined by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; continued failure creates liability for damages but does not automatically trigger strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (corporate income tax return and supplementary declarations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual window generally from early August through mid-September of the succeeding taxable year; exact date is assigned by the last digit of the company's NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 20% of the primary tax due or a minimum of 300 UVT, plus monthly default interest; persistent noncompliance may lead DIAN enforced collection, embargoes, and closure of the commercial establishment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización anual de beneficiarios finales (annual final beneficial owner register update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual deadline set by DIAN resolution according to the last digit of the NIT, normally within the first half of the calendar year; the filing must reflect all share transfers from the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update the final beneficial owner information may trigger fines under DIAN Resolution 164/2021, delay RUT renewals and foreign-trade authorizations, and constitute an aggravating factor in tax enforcement proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a revisor fiscal if, at the prior year-end: (1) total assets exceed 5,000 statutory monthly minimum wages; (2) gross ordinary income exceeds 3,000 statutory monthly minimum wages; or (3) the company is listed, is a public-interest entity, or is otherwise required by law or the Superintendencia de Sociedades. Below these thresholds an independent audit may still be contractually or license-required for a commercial shipyard.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Decreto 2420/2015; larger and public-interest entities apply full IFRS, while a mid-size S.A.S. may apply IFRS for SMEs. Financial statements must be prepared in Spanish and expressed in Colombian pesos.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must annually review and confirm in the DIAN Beneficiarios Finales system the natural persons holding directly or indirectly at least 5% of capital, voting rights, or economic benefits, or exercising control. Share transfers during the year must be recorded in the shareholders' register and reflected in the next annual confirmation; a transfer by endorsement does not suspend the duty to update the final beneficial owner record.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Socios)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minute Book of the Board of Directors, if a board has been constituted
Register of Corporate Representatives and Authorized Officers

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250-600 per year for a registered office and correspondence address in a major Colombian port city; no separate statutory corporate agent is required for an S.A.S.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000-15,000 per year for a medium-sized commercial shipyard entity under full IFRS; a mandatory revisor fiscal engagement generally ranges from USD 8,000 to USD 25,000 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Corporation Income Tax, Impuesto sobre la Renta, for taxable years commencing on or after 1 January 2025; the 2024-2026 surtax of 10 percentage points on taxable income exceeding 120,000 UVT is not treated as headline for this shipyard scope unless the entity's annual taxable income surpasses the threshold).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to commercial container-vessel shipyards. The Regular Shipyard Activity (Zona Franca Permanente Especial) regime is available for qualifying industrial users, granting a 25% income tax rate on export-linked ship repair/construction income and VAT exemption on qualifying maritime inputs, provided the taxpayer holds a prior zoning authorization from the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) filed exclusively through DIAN MUISCE electronic portal; Formulario 100 for withholding-agent monthly declarations where applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal year aligned to calendar year unless a different commercial year is authorized by DIAN).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment deadline is the first to ninth night according to the taxpayer's NIT last two digits, between the 1st and 9th calendar days of the ninth month after the fiscal year-end. For shipyards with maritime export turnover, a complementary ex-officio declaration may be required if the taxpayer fails to report taxable fringe benefits for crew and foreign vessel repair services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIIU/ISIC code: 3011 (Construcción de buques y otras embarcaciones) with maritime vessel building subdivision; the taxpayer must verify DIAN economic activity list for ocean-going container vessel shipyard.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned Colombian S.A.S., the activity and the Domicilio Fiscal must coincide with the Colombian registered office; the non-resident's foreign permanent establishment status is disregarded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from ship construction contracts, conversion, and repair services, including progress billings under maritime installment letters of credit (LC) or escrow-funded vessels.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare gross revenue net of VAT; on an accrual basis per Colombian GAAP. Attach a schedule of contract completion percentage under IFRS 15 if revenue from vessel construction exceeds 10% of total gross revenues.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, direct material (steel, hull armor), direct labor, auxiliary vessel machinery, and permitted deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs from aborted foreign outsourcing agreements must trace to arm's-length invoices; transfer pricing adjustments must be reflected in this field when the counterparty is a related offshore entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after prior-year loss compensation, depletion, and excess of 20% depreciation under the maritime accelerated depreciation option (annual equivalent to the straight-line rate, maximum 20% per year).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforwards of Colombian source losses only; foreign vessel-lease losses may not be offset if economically separate from Colombian shipyard activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax computed at 35% on taxable income; the new 2024-2026 surtax, where applicable, must be computed separately on the tentative liquid profit exceeding 120,000 UVT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident's withholding on deemed dividend distribution is not included in this box; it appears in Annex 48 as a credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits for qualifying maritime R&D investment in container vessel design and automated ship assembly digitalization (up to 20% of R&D expenditure subject to capping by DIAN).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign blue-water ship-management fees and foreign legal counsel cost deductions are not automatically eligible; the taxpayer must hold an advance cost-stock certificate for foreign services subject to Colombian withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 70 (Saldo a favor / Sanción por improcedencia)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payable balance or prepayment credit; the corresponding section includes late-return penalty basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident dividend withholding credit attributable to the S.A.S. is only refundable when the Colombian entity files an ex-officio claim and proves treaty status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the payable tax, increasing by 1.5% per month or fraction thereof, up to 120% of the payable tax; minimum penalty of 50 UVT (approx. COP 2.4 million in 2025). Unjustified non-filing carries an automatic 0.5% monthly surcharge for ten months (maximum 20% of tax due). Incorrectly calculated taxable bases are subject to a 160% surcharge on diverted profit and daily interest at the statutory rate (approx. 24% annual rate).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 350 (Declaración de Retención en la Fuente a Título de Renta) filed monthly via DIAN portal; required for payments to foreign ship-chartering, freight-forwarding and technology licensors.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (period May to April tax year)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Month-end closing date, due the 13th calendar day of the following month.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding at 15% (statutory) or 14.5% for treaty-qualified royalties on vessel-design licences and hull-engineering software.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficiary must provide a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the home jurisdiction; otherwise the 33% gross-rate applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding at 15% on interest paid to foreign creditors on ship-financing loans, Escrow financing or instalment LC discount fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty-lowered interest rates (most DTAs: 5% to 10%) apply where the Colombian S.A.S. furnishes the foreign creditor's TRC and the payment is made through an authorised Colombian financial institution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding at 15% on service fees paid to offshore ship design consultants, classification-society fees and foreign surveying firms.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the payment is for transferred intangible or embedded software, the rate rises to 33%; the contract must describe separable IP rights.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Monthly non-withholding penalty of 100% of the unpaid withholding amount; daily default interest at 24% nominal. Failure to file multiple monthly declarations is an aggravating forestry for tax evasion sanctions under Article 402 of the Colombian Criminal Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% for dividends distributed to non-resident natural persons or foreign legal entities from previously taxed Colombian corporate profits (Law 2277 of 2022 increased the general rate from 5% to 10% for taxable years 2024 onwards; payments to non-resident shareholders holding a bilateral DTA may be reduced to 0% or 5% if the DTA provides for a participation exemption).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A qualifying non-resident shareholder must submit to the paying Colombian S.A.S. a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) for the immediately preceding year (or current year if the fiscal year links to the dividend payment date), together with the Form D-3 Declaration of Beneficial Ownership; the S.A.S. files the information return with DIAN within the month following the dividend payment. Reduced withholding requires the beneficial owner to have held at least 10% of the voting capital for a holding period equal to the DTA holding period (typically 365 days).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalty withholding: statutory 33% (and 15% for software use embedded in vessel hardware if it is not a transfer of industrial secret); DTA rate generally 5% to 12% (Spain DTA: 5% for royalties through OECD-style; Canada DTA: 5% industrial/commercial royalties; Mexico DTA: 10% if approximate accrual). Interest withholding: statutory 15%; DTA lowered rates of 5% (financial-institution interest), 10% (other interest) under many Colombian DTAs (e.g., Spain 5%, France 5%, Canada 10%). Payments to a non-resident bank for letters of credit and export financing are typically exempt from Colombian interest WHT under Article 408 of the Colombian Tax Code if the lender is a foreign bank recognised by the local banking supervision authority.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Informative transfer pricing return (Formulario 120-2) is mandatory when gross income for the taxable year exceeds 10,000 UVT (approx. COP 500 million in 2025) or assets exceed 6,000 UVT. Full Local File / TP Report (Informe de Precios de Transferencia) is required when gross income exceeds 45,000 UVT or net worth exceeds 30,000 UVT. Master File and Country-by-Country report apply only for multinational groups exceeding EUR 750 million consolidated revenue (COP equivalent defined by DIAN).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Colombian Economic Substance Regime (Art. 57-1 of the Colombian Tax Code, as amended by Law 1430/2010) applies to S.A.S. entities with non-resident shareholders; the entity must prove premises, management, employees, functional identity and Colombian-source income; a shipyard S.A.S. must maintain a physical yard, fixed installations, hull assembly workforce, and invoicing records in Colombia. Failure to demonstrate economic substance leads to reclassification of the company as a shell colony and denial of foreign DTA benefits and possible deemed-dividend recognition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately undervaluing progress revenue from maritime LC instalments, artificial allocation of vessel manufacturing margin to a Panamanian related company, or inflating deductible overseas survey fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion penalty: up to 200% of the evaded tax; civil surcharge of 100% of the omitted tax plus daily interest at the legal rate. Administrative fine up to 20,000 UVT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling officers may be jointly liable for the unpaid tax if they were aware of the evasion and failed to correct; travel ban issuance by DIAN is possible; imprisonment under Art. 402 of Colombian Criminal Code up to 9 years for aggravated tax fraud, and separate asset restraining for funds misdirected into shell jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: No contemporaneous TP study for a S.A.S. with foreign marine-implementation group revenues above the local-file threshold; using unrelated non-comparable benchmark rates for Dutch-flagged vessel chartering interposed with a Monaco sister line; interposed service fees without mark-up.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment increases the taxable income; penalty for late or non-submission of the TP Report: 1% of the transaction value for each month of delay up to 3% and no less than 1,500 UVT; possible 20% surcharge on the adjusted tax due if the taxpayer failed to keep supporting documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the surcharges if they signed the annual declaration certifying the absence of a TP adjustment; in severe causes, a director facing disclosure bears joint and several liability under Article 794 of the Commercial Code if he/she intervened in the concealment, and may be barred from re-entering Colombian territory pending fiscal criminal investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Incorporating an S.A.S. dedicated exclusively to financing the construction of container vessels while all commercial decisions, treasury, and remote crews are handled through a foreign head office; no steel-mill contracts, no coordinating legal entity in Colombia.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN can disregard the Colombian S.A.S. for tax purposes, re-attributing the profits to the foreign parent; penalty is a 100% surcharge on the diverted taxable base, and assessment of unlimited foreign interest for repatriation under the CFC-like provision.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors like the named Colombian resident agent become jointly liable with the foreign parent up to the amount of diverted funds; directors may face travel bans until the fiscal debt is secured; if the substance deficiency was personal enrichment, they are subject to criminal confiscation proceedings under Colombian anti-money-laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering through Escrow/Letters of Credit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using an Escrow Account to accept hefty advance instalment payments for vessel construction without proper supporting import permits, without shipyard capacity, or with final real-party-interest converted through known-complicated foreign banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal liability under Law 599, Art. 323: imprisonment 10-15 years; financial penalties up to 1,200 minimum wages; the S.A.S. and legal representatives are subject to their own corporate penalty of a fine between 20,000 and 100,000 UVT and confiscation of the funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face immediate preventive suspension and prosecution; civil restitution to the illicit origin of the funds applies to all board members who authorised the channel; travel restriction is automatic until the seized amount is settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting interest or royalties to a Singaporean licensor without applying 15% WHT; paying a Monaco charter-in of hull integration fees under a bare-boat agreement without Colombian WHT on foreign services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding deficiency plus 100% surcharge; the Colombian withholding agent remains solely liable for the unpaid amount, including default interest from the due date. Daily interest 24%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible director is jointly and severally liable for withheld sums if the entity insolvent; personal cash seizure is possible; if the omission was deliberate, imprisonment of up to 4-8 years applies as a withholding-agent crime under Art. 394 of Criminal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repeatedly filing Form 110 after the statutory deadline and not honouring the accumulated monthly surcharge; failure to e-file the transfer pricing informative return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic monthly 0.5% surcharge up to 20% of tax due; late filing penalty of 5%-120% of due tax. Accumulated fines may trigger DIAN forced-collection and asset attachment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directorial responsibility for timeliness is statutory; if a director caused the non-filing, he/she may be reduced to a sanction of personal monetary fine of 100-200 UVT plus prohibition of leaving the country for up to two months.
